product_summary: HDFC Bank Home Loans provide financing for purchase of residential properties, construction on owned plots, and property improvements. Loans available up to ₹10 Crore with flexible repayment options.

pricing.other_charges_notes: Fixed rate loans: 2% prepayment charge plus taxes. Adjustable/floating rate: nil prepayment charges. Conversion fee up to 0.50% or ₹3000 whichever is lower. Property document retention: ₹1000/month after 60 days from closure.

documents_required: Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/NREGA Job Card/NPR Letter/Aadhaar
Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss statements (last 2 years for self-employed)
key_features: Multiple repayment options: Standing instructions, ECS, employer deduction, post-dated cheques
Customized repayment plans including SURF (Step Up Repayment Facility)
FLIP (Flexible Loan Installments Plan) for varying repayment capacity
Financing for new construction, resale, plot purchase, home renovation, and extension
24/7 customer support via chat, WhatsApp, phone
Tax benefits under sections 80C, 24(b), 80EEA of Income Tax Act
Combination rate loans (part fixed, part floating)
Balance transfer facility from other lenders
Special rates for salaried and self-employed professionals
Senior citizen discount on service charges (10%)
fees_table_raw: Processing Fee: Salaried/Self-Employed Professional - 0.50% of loan or ₹4,000 (whichever higher); Self-Employed Non-Professional - 1.50% or ₹5,000 (whichever higher). Conversion to lower rate variable: 0.50% or ₹3,000 (whichever lower) for first conversion, then ₹2,000 (whichever lower). Prepayment charges: Fixed rate 2% + taxes; Adjustable rate nil. Premature closure fixed rate: 2% + taxes except own sources. Payment return: ₹450. Custody charges: ₹1,000/month after 2 months from closure. Administrative charges: ₹5,000 + taxes. Re-appraisal after 6 months: ₹3,300-₹5,000.
